properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Make an image

1. Write naturally in the **Director**.
2. Add references only when needed; they become ordered `@Image1`, `@Image2`, … cards.
3. Choose the image role, retention, aspect, resolution, and seed.
4. Queue the workflow.

> [!TIP]
> With no references, Auto uses FL2VA text-to-image immediately. Multi-reference work uses REF2VA.

nodes.title: Prompt enhancement · what actually happens

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Two deliberate Qwen stages

- **Analyze image pixels**: Qwen3-VL creates factual source descriptions and repairs automatic roles.
- **Prompt enhancement**: a compact text-only Qwen pass turns the request and facts into a production direction.

The default writer is **Same as image analyzer**, so Auto 4B does both jobs with one loaded checkpoint. Select Auto 8B or an explicit file only when you accept staging a second model. Fingerprints and both stage caches survive normal reruns.

nodes.title: Routing · deliberate defaults

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Auto is the safe default

- **0 references:** FL2VA text-to-image
- **1 anchor:** FL2VA image-to-image when requested
- **Multiple references:** REF2VA

> [!WARNING]
> Forced routes are diagnostic controls. Invalid reference/route combinations are rejected before model work starts.

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## What local checks prove

Syntax, state migration, prompt compilation, resolution math, routes, registration, and graph integrity are checked here.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> CUDA generation, installed model filenames, VRAM, speed, and visual quality require the real Lightning workspace. Follow `docs/LIGHTNING_TEST_PLAN.md`.

nodes.title: Why the Director is not hidden in the subgraph

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Why this layout is intentional

The visible **Director** owns rich Studio state, reference cards, and `@Image` editing. The reusable subgraph owns ordinary typed sampling and exact-frame decode sockets.

Keeping that boundary avoids invisible promoted widgets and makes the main path readable.

nodes.title: Image reference semantics

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Choose what each image contributes

- `identity` / `character` + `fully_preserved`: keep the exact person or design.
- `style` + `attribute_transfer`: borrow rendering language, not content.
- `composition` / `layout`: borrow placement and hierarchy.
- `outfit`, `pose`, `typography`, `lighting`, `texture`, `object`, and `environment`: narrow transfers.

**Explicit card metadata always wins** over inference.

nodes.title: Sampling and frame extraction

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Profiles and decode

- **Base Quality / Balanced:** native H3; no acceleration files.
- **LightX v0.1:** Kijai's empirical four-step ComfyUI recipe.
- **PDD 600 / 900:** four-step REF2VA students; requires references and Mamad8's node package.

The Director's **Decoder** control chooses the original H3 Video VAE or the fastest experimental T=1 Image VAE. Temporal quality controls 5/9/13/20-frame video packets. Current ComfyUI chunked H3 VAE I/O reduces memory with identical pixels; it is not advertised as a speed boost.

nodes.title: Benchmark Lab - quality and speed diagnosis

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values:
## Compare two or many setups

1. Enter Base, LightX, or PDD profiles and resolution targets.
2. Check the exact generation count shown on the node.
3. Turn **Benchmark ON** in the purple Run mode switch.

Normal sampling stays lazy and is not scheduled. Same seed is the fairest comparison; new seeds are for diversity sweeps. Disable live cells for maximum throughput.

nodes.title: Upscaling, outpainting, and inpainting

properties.purpose: Documentation only; never enters the generation graph.

widgets_values: Upscaling is safest after H3's selected still: use ComfyUI's built-in Upscale Model Loader + Image Upscale With Model and a trusted image upscaler. H3 semantic outpainting works by increasing the target aspect ratio and explicitly placing the original reference within the new frame. Exact mask inpainting is not implemented here: H3 Studio has no verified mask-conditioned H3 route, and ComfyUI's VAE Encode for Inpainting requires a model trained for that contract. The node will not pretend semantic reference editing is pixel-locked inpainting.
